statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. If there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(cards) and cards[i] = cards[j], then r != -1 and r = min{ R - L + 1 | 0 <= L <= R < len(cards) and there exist p and q with L <= p < q <= R and cards[p] = cards[q] }. If no such indices i and j exist, then r = -1.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the precondition holds, the function returns a result r; it does not fail.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1 or 2 <= r <= len(cards).
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1 if and only if for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(cards), cards[i] != cards[j].
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r != -1, r = 1 + min{ j - i | 0 <= i < j < len(cards) and cards[i] = cards[j] }.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r != -1, there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < j < len(cards), cards[i] = cards[j], and j - i = r - 1.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r != -1, for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(cards) and cards[i] = cards[j], we have r - 1 <= j - i.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r != -1, there exists an index L with 0 <= L <= len(cards) - r such that the consecutive segment cards[L], cards[L+1], ..., cards[L+r-1] contains two equal cards: there exist p and q with L <= p < q <= L+r-1 and cards[p] = cards[q].
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r != -1, for every index L and every length s with 1 <= s < r and 0 <= L and L + s <= len(cards), the consecutive segment cards[L], cards[L+1], ..., cards[L+s-1] contains no two equal cards: for all p and q with L <= p < q < L+s, cards[p] != cards[q].
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 2 if and only if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(cards) - 1 and cards[i] = cards[i+1].
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Let rev be the slice of length len(cards) defined by rev[i] = cards[len(cards) - 1 - i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards). Whenever minimum_card_pickup(cards) returns r and minimum_card_pickup(rev) returns r_rev, r = r_rev.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Let f be any injective function from the set { cards[i] | 0 <= i < len(cards) } to the 64-bit integers in [0, 1000000], and let cards2 be the slice with len(cards2) = len(cards) and cards2[i] = f(cards[i]) for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards). Whenever minimum_card_pickup(cards) returns r and minimum_card_pickup(cards2) returns r2, r = r2.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.

statement: For every k with 1 <= k <= len(cards), let pref be the slice of length k with pref[i] = cards[i] for every i with 0 <= i < k. Whenever minimum_card_pickup(cards) returns r and minimum_card_pickup(pref) returns r_pref, if r_pref != -1 then r != -1 and r <= r_pref.
preconditions: cards is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(cards) <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(cards), 0 <= cards[i] <= 1000000.
